translation_notes: prefixes: ns_dc->nsdc, ns_ht->nsht, ns_xsd->nsxsd, ns_distill->nsdistill, ns_rdfa->nsrdfa

self.graph designated as current graph with @graph self.graph (not reassigned in the region, so the value-capture subtlety in INSTRUCTIONS.md 2bis does not bite); the bnode/htbnode subject and every predicate the method writes are lexical, so +{ } reaches all of them even though top_class/info_class/context/msg/node arrive as parameters -- only their term VALUES are data, the pattern itself is written, unlike the pitfall INSTRUCTIONS.md warns this region's name suggests.

the two same-subject predicate lists (nsdc:description ; nsdc:date on bnode, and a ; nsht:requestURI on htbnode) each collapse into one +{ } joined by ';' -- exactly the construction this stratum exercises; the two conditional rdf:type/context triples stay separate +{ } statements (an `if` guards each, and `+{ }` is accepted as a one-line suite per INSTRUCTIONS.md 2bis) since folding a maybe-absent triple into the same ';' list would need a bound value in all cases.

context shim (processor_context.py) restores ProcessorGraph and ns_rdf: the extracted region's context window carried neither the class (self.graph binding) nor `from rdflib import RDF as ns_rdf`, both verified against the pinned commit's options.py/__init__.py.

original.py's own `self.graph.bind(...)` calls are left as plain rdflib calls (unrelated to the lexical @prefix declarations, which only resolve prefixed names at transpile time) -- kept verbatim on both sides for fidelity.

Credit correction (2026-11-02, corpus/403 defect 3): dropped `@prefix` for `nsdistill:`, declared by the mechanical draft but never used as a term in the translated region (and not among the bindings the original sets on its graph); `rdfeval check` stays OK.

repair.credit: unused prefix declarations dropped from translated.ldpy

optimization_notes: optimized.py: `graph = self.graph` once instead of thirteen `self.graph`; `full_msg = msg` set first so the `else` branch goes (the try/except on node.nodeName is kept); `ns["term"]` item access becomes attribute access; the three unconditional adds on bnode are grouped before `if info_class` (order is irrelevant to the graph); `Literal("%s" % context)` becomes `Literal(str(context))` (context is a URIRef or a str by the guard). The basestring try/except and the six bind calls are kept.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `@graph graph`; the three unconditional bnode triples become one `+{ {bnode} a … ; nsdc:description … ; nsdc:date …^^nsxsd:dateTime }`; Literal(full_msg) becomes a bare {full_msg} (a str in pyRdfa: plain literal by coercion); Literal(x, datatype=xsd:dateTime) becomes `{x}^^nsxsd:dateTime` (isoformat() is already a str).

Exception to the symmetry (island only): the context branch writes `+{ {bnode} nsrdfa:context [ a nsht:Request ; nsht:requestURI {str(context)} ] }`; the `[ ]` blank node property list removes the `htbnode = BNode()` line, which Python cannot do without the variable.
Demo harness copied as is. Symmetry otherwise line for line.
